changes.originalFinding: LIR002-NATIVE-COLLECTOR: FAIL (filter/synthetic mixed Basic and Advanced configuration styles)
changes.rootCause: The filter processor (contrib 0.164.0) forbids mixing flat string conditions with object {context,conditions} entries in the same conditions list.
changes.change: Rewrote trace_conditions and metric_conditions to consistent Advanced OTTL object style; kept error_mode: propagate and the synthetic-only boundary (resource attribute neshane.synthetic==true; metric name allowlist).
changes.technicalRationale: Match the filter processor Advanced config documented for 0.164.0.
changes.securityImpact: None weakened: filtering, attribute minimization, no logs pipeline and bounded retries are preserved.
changes.expectedBehavior: Native `validate --config` exits 0; collector starts and enforces the synthetic boundary.

changes.originalFinding: LIR002-HOST-*: FAIL (8 localhost-published ports unreachable; NetworkSettings.Ports empty)
changes.rootCause: internal:true networks suppress host port publication on Docker Desktop (confirmed by A/B test: internal => empty binding + unreachable, default => binding + reachable).
changes.change: Removed internal:true from postgres, broker, mail, telemetry networks; retained internal:true for the unpublished redis network.
changes.technicalRationale: Host ingress requires a bridge gateway; Docker Desktop does not create the host binding on internal networks.
changes.securityImpact: Loopback-only binds, network segmentation, no-privileged and resource limits remain. Container egress isolation is no longer provided for published services (documented trade-off).
changes.expectedBehavior: Published ports appear in NetworkSettings.Ports and are reachable from the host.

changes.originalFinding: Experimental SeaweedFS S3 host port unreachable (same internal network root cause)
changes.change: Removed internal:true from the experimental network.

changes.originalFinding: Static validator encoded the wrong all-networks-internal assertion
changes.rootCause: The validator asserted every network is internal, which contradicted the corrected networking model.
changes.change: Now asserts task-scoped (non-external) networks; a network is internal only when none of its services publishes a host port. Also excludes the reviews/ evidence directory from the baseline file scan.
changes.technicalRationale: Keep static validation consistent with the corrected Docker Desktop networking model and exclude runtime evidence from baseline-config checks.
changes.securityImpact: Strengthens the invariant (published<=>non-internal) instead of weakening it.
changes.expectedBehavior: Static validator passes with the corrected config.

changes.originalFinding: Documentation described all networks as internal:true (now incorrect)
changes.change: Documented segmentation (not egress isolation) as the boundary; internal:true retained only for Redis; host-port networks must be non-internal.
changes.validation: Static validator README boundary check PASS.

notChanged: No 002 evidence modified. No image reference/digest changed. No service definition, healthcheck, volume, credential placeholder or resource limit changed beyond the networking correction and Collector filter syntax.
